parsed.explanation: The objection identifies a genuine mismatch: v(B) is defined using decreasing order, while Lemma 4.1 proves realizability only for some ordering. The displayed example confirms nested absolute differences are order-dependent. Section 4’s cutting strategy then processes the decreasingly listed B, so it cannot use the arbitrary realizing order without changing the definitions and strategy wording. No other passage supplies the universal upper bound. The proof can be repaired locally by defining chains as ordered sequences (or minimizing over orderings) and processing B in the realizing order.
